breve: Spatial entity tracker for our spatial entity marker tracking extension.
descricao: Spatial entity tracker for our OpenXR spatial entity marker tracking extension. These trackers identify entities in our real space detected by a visual marker such as a QRCode or Aruco code, and map their location to our virtual space.

metodos.desc: Returns the marker data for this marker. This can return a String or PackedByteArray. Only applicable to QR Code based markers.

Sets the marker data for this marker.
Note: This should only be set by marker discovery logic.

propriedades.desc: The bounds size for this marker.
The marker ID for this marker, this is only returned for Aruco and April Tag markers. Call 'get_marker_data' for QRCode markers.
